items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: I was with Lee Collins one night, and he told me he seen a cat down at 31st Estate.

ctx.x: Do you remember what make it was? Who made it?

It was the Slingerland. A Slingerland? Yeah, it was the Slingerland. Yeah, it was the Slingerland. It was the old make. It was the Slingerland. But that thing was beautiful. And I kept it just like new. Them guys just took it. I never could find out where it went. Never could find out. I was with Lee Collins one night, and he told me he seen a cat down at 31st Estate. That's where the Union Hall was at in Chicago, you know? Oh yeah. You see a fella with a trap wrapped up, but he didn't know if it was his or not.…
